title: Yellowed Smoky Spanish Yellow Split Peas Paella
description: A plant-based Andalusian dish featuring yellow split peas and wok-hei, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This paella is a grassy, aerated meal-prep option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the bell pepper and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yellow split peas, salt, and 2 cups of water to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the tomato to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir the paella constantly over high heat for 2 minutes to achieve the wok-hei effect.
